status: Answered date semantics and supplied six sourced product/vintage records; whole locked-corpus version reconciliation and older-vintage acquisition remain to execute.
repo_scope_correction: The manifest covers three publishers but at least six distinct observation products: CAINC1, SARPP, MARPP, FMR, Section 8 Income Limits and LAUS, besides reference tables. LAUS coverage is 79 seasonally-adjusted areas in the committed slice, not every town as a direct local estimate.
decision: Use the actual publisher release/notice for the specific value edition, retaining period, effective date, retrieval and knowledge as separate fields. A product calendar is a discovery/indexing source, not a timeless formula inferred from observation year. Do not silently show undated current/revised agency values as historical knowledge. Do not hide the whole panel because one product or edition is unavailable.
fields: publishedAt or evidence-backed known-by bound with basis
effectiveFrom/effectiveTo where it is an administrative value
in-world learnedAt/perception where individual knowledge matters

records.basis: Official BEA release header; the same release revises 2020–2023.
records.limit: Need compare the locked bytes and table edition to this release. A 2023 row revised in 2026 is not the 2023 estimate available in 2024.

records.product: BEA county personal income initial 2023 vintage
records.basis: Official original release; older-vintage alternative for a January 2026 world.
records.limit: Original vintage values have not been downloaded in this research pass. Do not date current revised 2023 values to this earlier release.

records.basis: Official RPP product page names state/metro current release; release header and table references establish SARPP.
records.limit: Verify exact locked table edition/geographic product before stamping rows. RPP compares relative price levels; it is not an inflation rate.

records.product: HUD FY2025 Fair Market Rents, original edition
records.basis: 89 FR 66127 / 2024-18002 original notice, subject to area reevaluation exceptions.
records.limit: A historical announcement can be known before its effective date. Verify whether locked rows are original or an area-specific later revision. The current HUD index itself shows later amendments, so fiscal year alone is insufficient.

records.basis: Official HUD document/data heading states effective date; precise initial posting timestamp not established here.
records.limit: Do not borrow FMR release dates or substitute MTSP/ESG products. The effective date supports program validity, not an asserted exact publication timestamp. Match official notice/bytes for a defensible known-by date.

records.product: BLS model-based LAUS January 2026 initial monthly release and annual revision
records.basis: Official archived release and annual revision notice.
records.limit: The annual revision also changes older periods. Other months and non-modeled substate products have their own actual release/revision dates. No fixed next-month day is supplied.

fallback: Prefer the latest demonstrably available older edition for that geography/measure/cutoff. Display its date and scope.

An unknown publisher timestamp stays unknown; do not relabel retrieval or observation period as release. Keep that exact agency edition out of historical public-news/certification use until a release or defensible known-by bound is established.

The player can still see appropriately labeled generated-world conditions and historical reference context where already authorized. That is an explicit simulation/baseline channel, not a false claim that a future agency release was known.

Retrospective calibration of a fictional 2026 world using subsequently estimated historical conditions is different from a simulated person reading a 2026 publication early. Preserve that distinction and the owner's bounded fictional-world variation.
No date computation, profile read or external reference refresh mutates actual simulated prices, payments or beliefs. Official reference data is not the simulation itself.
acquisition_recipe: Identify each locked file and current edition, not just corpus family.
Attach release metadata to that exact edition; use source archives for prior editions actually needed at Begin.
For mutable current-series files, carry separate release/vintage identities rather than assign each row its original-period release date.
Check the currently cited source calendars/archives at refresh; persist the resolved metadata so live web calls are not required in gameplay.
Complete HUD notice/edition matching first for a dated reference available at January 2026; do not wait for all economic products to be compiled before the known rows work.
checks: A September download of an already released original FY2025 FMR does not hide it until September.
A February2026 BEA release is not available as that release on January5,2026 despite describing2024.
A 2026-revised 2023 value is not backdated to the first2023 release.
An announced but not yet effective FMR may be reported as forthcoming, not charged as an active program rule.
Refreshing a retrieval timestamp does not remove previously established availability.
Missing LAUS local coverage uses correctly labeled wider geography or absence, never pretends a state figure is measured at every town.
Source publication and actual in-world knowledge remain separate.
